title: max_fan_in constraints are parsed but never evaluated
description:
ConstraintResolver::resolve (src/constraints/resolver.rs:59) has `_ => {}` for MaxFanIn — the kind is parsed from rules.toml, listed by sutra_constraints, displayed in docs/README, but generates no violations ever. Silent constraint theater: a user who sets max_fan_in believes they have a guardrail and doesn't. (mcp.rs:405 tool description does say "does not include max_fan_in", but rules.toml docs advertise the kind.)

Fix: evaluate it — files table already has fan_in_files; check is `SELECT path, fan_in_files FROM files WHERE path = <target> AND fan_in_files > <threshold>` surfaced as a ConstraintFinding in check::evaluate. Until then, at minimum warn at load_rules time that the kind is inert. Found during sutra/needs-designing/14 exploration, 2026-06-11.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review (bb2f504..30331bd):

Verdict: needs-attention

[high] Changed-files review drops max_fan_in violations on imported targets (src/constraints/check.rs:363-365)
In ChangedFiles scope, the new max_fan_in loop filters findings to files whose own id is in changed_ids. Fan-in lives on the imported target, not the changed source. If a changed file adds an import to an unchanged target and that target crosses the threshold, sutra_review will skip the target because its id is not in changed_ids.
Recommendation: For ChangedFiles, evaluate max_fan_in for targets affected by changed outgoing edges or all rule-matching targets with changed incoming edges. Add a regression test.

[high] Proposed-edge guard path never evaluates max_fan_in (src/constraints/check.rs:593-595)
The guard's proposed-content path calls evaluate with EvalScope::Edges, but the max_fan_in block only runs for EvalScope::SingleFile. Edits with proposed imports skip fan-in thresholds entirely.
Recommendation: Handle EvalScope::Edges for max_fan_in by checking proposed target ids and computing effective fan-in from files.fan_in_files plus proposed incoming edges. Add a guard regression test.
